verificationPolicy.productionRule: Only facts traced to official Government sources are included.
sourceHierarchy: official State/UT portals for State-specific rules
verificationPolicy.fallback: If a required fact is missing, conflicting, outdated or State-specific but unverified, return INSUFFICIENT_VERIFIED_DATA.
verificationPolicy.urlPolicy: Official URLs only; no manually invented application URLs.
verificationPolicy.fieldRule: Every field must be supported by an official source or explicitly marked as State-dependent/not universally fixed. Unknown facts are not inferred.
verificationPolicy.currentDataWarning: Dynamic values such as deadlines, State notifications, fund releases, beneficiary lists and local procedures must be rechecked before a citizen-specific answer.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.purpose: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land recorded in the relevant State/UT land records.

eligibility.identification: State/UT Government identifies eligible farmer families according to scheme guidelines.

documents: land/land-record details as required by State/UT

application.authority: State/UT Government identification and PM-KISAN system

schemes.deadlines: No single national application deadline; identification/registration and verification are governed by the PM-KISAN system and State/UT processes.
schemes.grievance: Use the PM-KISAN official grievance/contact mechanisms and State/UT nodal authorities.
schemes.stateVariation: Land-record identification and verification are State/UT administered.
aiSafety: Do not recommend solely from self-declared land ownership; State/UT records and verification matter.
Do not treat ₹6,000 as a loan.
Do not infer eligibility for excluded categories.
eKYC is mandatory for registered farmers.
howItWorks: State/UT identifies eligible landholding farmer families
Eligibility and records are validated
eKYC is completed
₹2,000 is transferred in each of three instalments through DBT
applicationSteps: Use New Farmer Registration on the official PM-KISAN portal or the authorized assisted channel
Enter/submit required farmer, land and bank information
Complete eKYC
Use Know Your Status to check verification/payment status
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: ₹6,000 per year in three equal ₹2,000 instalments by DBT.
notGuaranteed: Registration alone does not guarantee payment; eligibility and State/UT verification apply.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay unofficial agents for guaranteed approval.
Use only the official PM-KISAN portal/authorized channels.
Never share OTP/PIN/password with callers claiming to be PM-KISAN officials.

sourceToFactMap.familyDefinition: Official PM-KISAN portal and revised guidelines
sourceToFactMap.exclusions: Official PM-KISAN portal and scheme guidelines

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.purpose: Crop insurance protection against notified crop losses and specified risks in notified areas and seasons.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Farmers, including eligible sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas and having insurable interest.

farmerPremiumCap.kharif_foodgrain_oilseeds: 2% of sum insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less
farmerPremiumCap.rabi_foodgrain_oilseeds: 1.5% of sum insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less
farmerPremiumCap.annual_commercial_horticultural: 5% of sum insured or actuarial rate, whichever is less

benefit.claimMode: insurance claim subject to scheme conditions and loss assessment

schemes.coverage: Coverage and risks depend on notified crop, area, season and applicable State notification; do not assume every crop or loss is covered.
documents: land records/Record of Rights or applicable land possession evidence for non-loanee farmers
applicable tenant/sharecropper agreement or State-permitted evidence

application.authority: PMFBY implementing channels notified by State/UT

schemes.deadlines: State/crop/season-specific; always check the current notified crop calendar and State/UT notification.
schemes.lossReporting: For specified individual post-harvest losses under the operational guidelines, immediate intimation within 72 hours applies; current applicable procedure must be followed.
schemes.stateVariation: State/UT notifications determine notified crops, areas, seasons, enrolment timelines and implementing arrangements.
aiSafety: Never state a fixed enrolment deadline without State + crop + season.
Never promise a claim amount.
Do not assume all natural disasters/losses are covered.
Use current PMFBY portal and applicable notification for loss reporting.
howItWorks: State/UT notifies crops, areas and seasons
Eligible farmer enrolls through the notified channel
Farmer pays applicable capped premium
Insurer provides cover for notified risks
Loss is assessed under the applicable mechanism and eligible claim is paid
applicationSteps: Check State/UT notification for crop, area and season
Check enrolment deadline
Apply through the notified bank/PACS/CSC/authorized channel or official portal where available
Keep policy/enrolment number and bank details
For applicable localized/post-harvest losses, report within the prescribed time
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Insurance claim payment is subject to the notified crop, insured area/sum insured, covered peril, loss assessment and applicable guidelines.
notGuaranteed: Insurance does not guarantee payment for every crop loss.
Coverage, enrolment deadline and claim methodology are notification-specific.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay anyone promising a guaranteed claim.
Do not miss the prescribed loss-intimation window.
Verify policy/enrolment details on the official PMFBY system.

sourceToFactMap.premiumCaps: 2023 PMFBY Operational Guidelines / official PMFBY portal

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card
schemes.authority: Department of Financial Services / Government of India
schemes.purpose: Timely and affordable institutional credit for agriculture and eligible allied activities.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Eligible farmers including owner cultivators, small and marginal farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs/JLGs of farmers and eligible allied-activity borrowers.

creditLimitFramework.missKccLoanLimit: up to ₹5 lakh, subject to applicable rules and lender assessment

benefit.shortTermAgriLoanRate: 7% for eligible short-term agri-loans up to ₹3 lakh under MISS
benefit.timelyRepaymentBenefit: additional 3% subvention for eligible timely repayment, making effective rate 4% for that component

eligibility.tenantSharecropperCoverage: covered subject to applicable bank/documentation rules

documents: land or cultivation/lease/tenancy evidence as applicable
other documents required by lending institution
schemes.deadlines: No universal national application deadline; lender and seasonal crop-credit timelines may apply.
schemes.grievance: Use the concerned lending institution's grievance mechanism and applicable banking grievance channels.
schemes.stateVariation: Lending operations, documentation and local implementation can vary by bank and State.
aiSafety: ₹5 lakh is a current framework/limit, not an automatic sanction.
Do not promise a loan or interest rate outside applicable MISS rules.
Collateral-free does not mean every KCC borrower is automatically eligible for ₹2 lakh.

source.authority: Department of Financial Services / Government of India
source.operationalGuidelines: Government of India PIB KCC backgrounder

howItWorks: Eligible farmer approaches participating lender
Bank assesses crop/allied activity, land/tenancy and repayment capacity
KCC limit is sanctioned according to applicable framework
Eligible short-term crop loans may receive MISS interest support
applicationSteps: Approach participating bank/KCC channel
Submit KYC and cultivation/allied-activity documents
Bank assesses eligibility and limit
Complete sanction and KCC/account formalities
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Credit facility, not a cash grant. Current MISS/KCC framework permits limits up to ₹5 lakh subject to rules and lender assessment.
notGuaranteed: ₹5 lakh is not an automatic sanction.
Collateral-free treatment up to ₹2 lakh is subject to applicable rules; it does not mean every applicant receives ₹2 lakh.
fraudWarnings: Never pay an unofficial person for guaranteed KCC approval.
Verify interest/subvention terms with the lending institution.

schemes.name: National Agriculture Market
schemes.purpose: Electronic agricultural market platform supporting transparent price discovery and access to buyers and markets.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Farmers/sellers using participating e-NAM mandis and eligible agricultural markets.

services: access to more markets and buyers

schemes.deadlines: No universal national deadline; transaction and market participation depend on the participating mandi and commodity/market rules.
schemes.grievance: Use e-NAM portal support/participating mandi mechanisms.
schemes.stateVariation: Mandi participation, commodities and local market procedures vary by State/UT and participating market.
aiSafety: e-NAM facilitates transparent bidding and market access; it does not guarantee a higher sale price.
Do not promise immediate sale time; transaction duration depends on mandi arrivals and season.
howItWorks: Farmer registers with e-NAM/participating APMC
KYC is completed
Produce is brought to participating mandi
Quality assaying and transparent electronic bidding can be used
Payment can be made electronically to the seller's bank account
applicationSteps: Visit/register through e-NAM
Select participating APMC
Provide mandatory details and documents
Complete APMC KYC/approval
Use dashboard/mobile services for market information and transactions
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: e-NAM facilitates electronic payment through methods such as RTGS, NEFT and BHIM UPI; actual sale price and transaction time depend on market conditions.
notGuaranteed: e-NAM does not guarantee a specific sale price or instant sale.
fraudWarnings: Use the official e-NAM portal and participating mandi.
Do not pay unofficial registration fees; official farmer registration is free.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
schemes.purpose: Medium- and long-term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Eligible farmers, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, PACS/cooperatives and other approved agri-infrastructure beneficiaries.

benefit.creditGuarantee: supported for eligible loans up to ₹2 crore
benefit.benefitType: interest-subvented credit, not a ₹2 crore cash grant

application.authority: Eligible lending institution through AIF system

schemes.deadlines: Facility/project timelines are governed by current AIF guidelines and lending arrangements.
schemes.grievance: Use lending institution and AIF/implementing authority grievance channels.
schemes.stateVariation: Project facilitation and local convergence can vary by State/UT.
aiSafety: AIF is financing support, not a universal cash grant.
₹2 crore refers to eligible credit/guarantee framework, not guaranteed money to every applicant.
Final sanction depends on project eligibility and lender appraisal.
howItWorks: Eligible beneficiary prepares an eligible infrastructure project
Project is appraised by an eligible lender
Loan is sanctioned subject to lender/project conditions
Government interest subvention applies to eligible loans
Credit guarantee support applies where eligible
applicationSteps: Identify eligible post-harvest/community-farming asset
Prepare project proposal and required documents
Apply through eligible lending institution/AIF workflow
Complete lender appraisal and sanction
Implement project and meet loan conditions
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Interest-subvented credit; AIF is not a universal direct cash grant.
notGuaranteed: ₹2 crore is an eligible credit/guarantee framework, not guaranteed funding to every applicant.
Final loan terms are lender/project dependent.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay anyone for guaranteed AIF sanction.
Verify the lender and project eligibility through official channels.

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission
schemes.purpose: Social, economic and institutional empowerment of rural poor households through women-led Self Help Groups, financial inclusion and livelihoods.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Rural poor households, with strong focus on mobilising rural women into Self Help Groups and federations.
documents: identity/KYC as required for SHG and bank linkage

application.authority: State Rural Livelihood Mission / district/block implementation structure

schemes.deadlines: No single universal citizen application deadline; mobilisation and programme components operate through State missions.
schemes.grievance: State Rural Livelihood Mission / district/block mission grievance mechanisms.
schemes.stateVariation: Implementation, SHG structures, livelihood components and local support vary by State/UT.
aiSafety: DAY-NRLM is not a universal fixed cash-payment scheme.
Do not promise a fixed grant to every woman.
Eligibility and benefits depend on SHG/community institution and State implementation.
howItWorks: Rural poor households are mobilized into women-led SHGs
SHGs are nurtured into sustainable community institutions
Members receive financial literacy and bank/credit linkage
Livelihood and enterprise activities are promoted
Higher-level federations and market linkages support scale
applicationSteps: Contact the local SHG/community resource person or State Rural Livelihood Mission
Join/form an eligible SHG through the local mission structure
Complete SHG records and bank linkage as applicable
Access relevant livelihood/credit/enterprise components
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Benefits are delivered through SHGs/community institutions, financial linkage, livelihood support and enterprise ecosystems rather than a single universal cash payment.
notGuaranteed: DAY-NRLM does not provide one fixed cash amount to every rural woman.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay unofficial agents for SHG membership or guaranteed credit.
Verify SHG/loan terms with the SHG, bank and State Rural Livelihood Mission.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.purpose: Provide clean LPG cooking access to eligible women from poor households.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Adult women from eligible poor households without another LPG connection in the household.

includedBenefits: eligible connection components covered under current PMUY provisions

documents: ration card/family composition document or permitted self-declaration for migrants
Aadhaar of beneficiary and adult family members as applicable

application.authority: Oil Marketing Company LPG distributor / PMUY

schemes.deadlines: Connection release depends on current PMUY allocation/extension and distributor processing; no single citizen-wide annual deadline.
schemes.grievance: PMUY helplines 14428/14438; LPG emergency 1906; OMC/MoPNG grievance channels.
schemes.stateVariation: State-specific documentation and any applicable stamp fee can vary; eligibility is governed by current PMUY rules.
aiSafety: Do not claim every LPG refill is free.
Current official PMUY portal explicitly provides first refill and stove free with the deposit-free connection.
Do not invent a current refill subsidy amount unless a current official order confirms it.
howItWorks: Eligible woman submits PMUY application/KYC
Household duplication and eligibility are checked
OMC releases deposit-free connection under current provisions
First refill and stove are provided free as specified by current PMUY portal
applicationSteps: Find nearest LPG distributor on PMUY portal
Complete KYC/application
Submit identity, address, family-composition, bank and deprivation documents as applicable
Complete distributor verification
Receive connection and first refill/stove under current PMUY benefits
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Deposit-free LPG connection; current official PMUY portal says Government cash assistance covers specified connection components and OMCs provide the first refill and stove free.
notGuaranteed: Future refill prices/subsidies are not the same as the initial PMUY connection benefit and must be checked separately.
fraudWarnings: Do not share OTP/bank PIN with fake LPG agents.
Use PMUY/OMC helplines and official distributor locator.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
schemes.authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.purpose: Provide institutional collateral-free credit to micro enterprises.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Eligible micro and small business entrepreneurs, including non-agricultural activities and specified activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping.

loanCategories.tarun: above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh
loanCategories.tarun_plus: above ₹10 lakh and up to ₹20 lakh for eligible entrepreneurs who previously availed and successfully repaid Tarun loans from 24.10.2024

application.portal: Department of Financial Services PMMY information

schemes.deadlines: No universal national application deadline; lending institution processing rules apply.
schemes.grievance: Use the concerned lending institution's grievance mechanism.
schemes.stateVariation: Lending products, interest rates, documentation and processing can vary by lender.
aiSafety: PMMY is a loan, not a grant.
Loan category does not guarantee sanction.
Interest rate, repayment period and final terms depend on the lending institution and applicable rules.

source.authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

howItWorks: Applicant approaches a member lending institution
Lender assesses microenterprise purpose and repayment capacity
Loan category is determined by amount and applicable PMMY rules
Eligible collateral-free credit is sanctioned/disbursed by lender
applicationSteps: Identify business purpose and required finance
Approach an eligible MLI
Submit KYC and business/project information
Complete lender appraisal
Receive sanction/disbursement if approved
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Loan/credit, not a grant. Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories have different limits.
notGuaranteed: No PMMY category guarantees approval, interest rate or a particular repayment period.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay an agent for guaranteed MUDRA approval.
Confirm lender is an eligible MLI.

sourceToFactMap.categories: Department of Financial Services PMMY page last updated 05 Feb 2026
sourceToFactMap.collateralFree: Department of Financial Services PMMY page
sourceToFactMap.memberLendingInstitutions: Department of Financial Services PMMY page

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
schemes.purpose: Provide maternity cash support for eligible women to compensate partly for wage loss and encourage health-seeking behaviour.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Eligible pregnant and lactating women belonging to specified socially/economically disadvantaged categories.

benefit.mode: Direct Benefit Transfer to bank/post-office account

eligibleCategories: other categories prescribed by Central Government

firstChild: pregnancy registration and required ANC milestones
child's first cycle of universal immunization up to 14 weeks
secondGirlChild: pregnancy registration and required ANC milestones
child's first cycle of universal immunization up to 14 weeks

schemes.deadlines: Eligible beneficiary can register up to 270 days from childbirth under current FAQ; milestone-specific timing applies.

stateVariation.note: These States are not implementing PMMVY because they operate their own maternity benefit schemes.

schemes.grievance: PMMVY portal/State WCD or Social Welfare implementation channels.
aiSafety: Do not recommend PMMVY in Odisha or Telangana without checking the State's replacement maternity scheme.
₹6,000 applies only to eligible second-child girl cases.
Do not omit milestone conditions.
howItWorks: Eligible pregnant/lactating woman registers through PMMVY system/Anganwadi/ASHA
Eligibility and Aadhaar-linked payment details are verified
Required health milestones are recorded
Benefit is transferred by DBT when conditions are met
applicationSteps: Register through PMMVY portal or Anganwadi/ASHA
Provide Aadhaar, mobile, bank/post-office and eligibility details
Submit pregnancy/child and health milestone information
Track status through the official system/local implementation channel
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: ₹5,000 for first living child in two instalments; ₹6,000 for eligible second child when the second child is a girl, in one instalment, subject to conditions.
notGuaranteed: Payment depends on eligibility and completion/verification of required milestones.
Odisha and Telangana are not implementing PMMVY and have their own maternity schemes.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay unofficial agents for PMMVY registration.
Do not share OTP or bank credentials.

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
schemes.purpose: Placement-linked skill development for poor rural youth to improve employability and access to regular wage employment.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Poor rural youth generally aged 15–35 years; upper age limit is 45 for women and specified special groups under applicable rules.
documents: rural/household eligibility documents as required by State implementing agency
education/qualification documents where course requires them

application.authority: State implementing agency / approved DDU-GKY training centre

schemes.deadlines: Course/batch-specific; no single national citizen deadline.
schemes.grievance: Training centre, State DDU-GKY implementing agency and Ministry/official programme grievance channels.
schemes.stateVariation: Course availability, centres, implementing agencies and batch schedules vary by State/UT.
aiSafety: Placement-linked does not mean a guaranteed job for every candidate.
Do not promise a specific salary.
Always check current approved training centre/course availability.
howItWorks: Eligible rural youth selects an approved training pathway
Training is delivered through approved centres/implementing agencies
Candidates receive skill training and assessment/certification
Programme is placement-linked with mandatory social inclusion requirements
applicationSteps: Find an approved DDU-GKY training centre/course
Complete candidate registration and eligibility verification
Attend training and assessment
Use placement support after certification
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Skill training and placement support; programme documents describe placement linkage and a minimum placement requirement for implementing projects.
notGuaranteed: Do not promise a specific employer, salary or job location.
Training centre/course availability varies by State and batch.
fraudWarnings: Verify that the centre/course is approved.
Do not pay unofficial fees for a guaranteed job.

schemes.name: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
schemes.purpose: Statutory rural wage-employment guarantee and rural livelihood/asset creation framework.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work and satisfy the Act's conditions.
documents: current rural employment/job-card records as required

verification.existingMGNREGAJobCardsTransition: Existing job cards remain valid during transition until replacement/issuance of Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards as applicable.

application.authority: Gram Panchayat / designated local implementation system
application.portal: Official VB-G RAM G Government system

schemes.deadlines: Employment is demand-driven; applicable demand, work allocation and wage-payment timelines follow the Act/rules.
schemes.grievance: Use Gram Panchayat/block/district implementation and official VB-G RAM G grievance mechanisms.
schemes.stateVariation: Implementation systems and administrative procedures may vary by State/UT, within the central Act/framework.
aiSafety: Do not use MGNREGA as the current programme after 01-07-2026.
Current statutory guarantee is 125 days, not 100 days.
Do not promise a particular worksite or wage amount without current applicable rules/rates.
Do not assume every household automatically receives 125 days without the required work demand and eligibility conditions.

source.operationalGuidelines: PIB VB-G RAM G FAQ and launch releases

howItWorks: Adult members of eligible rural households demand unskilled manual work
Gram Panchayat/local system registers and processes demand
Work is allocated within the statutory framework
Attendance and muster records are maintained
Wages are paid by DBT; unemployment allowance/delay compensation applies where statutory conditions are met
applicationSteps: Approach Gram Panchayat/designated local system
Register household/workers and obtain/retain applicable employment card
Submit demand for work
Receive work allocation and attend assigned work
Track wage payment and grievance status
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: 125 days of statutory wage employment per eligible rural household per financial year; wages are transferred to bank/post-office accounts. Official May 2026 release stated weekly or within 15 days of muster-roll closure, with delay compensation subject to the Act.
notGuaranteed: 125 days is a statutory guarantee against demand and applicable conditions; it is not an automatic 125-day cash payment.
Do not describe MGNREGA as the current programme after 1 July 2026.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay for a job card or work demand.
Use Gram Panchayat/designated official channels.

sourceToFactMap.125Days: PIB official VB-G RAM G releases

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin
schemes.purpose: Financial assistance for eligible rural households to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Eligible houseless rural households and households living in eligible kutcha/dilapidated housing identified through prescribed SECC/Awaas+ and exclusion criteria.

benefit.minimumHouseSize: 25 sq. m including dedicated hygienic cooking area

exclusionChecks: landholding thresholds and other prescribed criteria

schemes.deadlines: Beneficiary selection and survey windows are administrative/State-specific; no universal walk-in application deadline.
schemes.grievance: Gram Panchayat/block/district PMAY-G grievance and State Rural Development channels.
schemes.stateVariation: State/UT implementation, beneficiary verification and land/site procedures vary.
aiSafety: Do not tell a citizen that simply filling a form guarantees a house.
Selection depends on prescribed deprivation/exclusion criteria and verification.
Do not use outdated MGNREGA-specific wage convergence figures without current VB-G RAM G rules.
howItWorks: Eligible rural households are identified through prescribed data and surveys
Deprivation and exclusion criteria are checked
Beneficiary is verified/sanctioned
Construction progresses through prescribed stages
Assistance is released through DBT-linked process and convergence
applicationSteps: Check inclusion/identification through Gram Panchayat/Awaas system
Participate in prescribed Awaas+/verification process when open
Provide bank/land/household information
Complete sanction and construction-stage requirements
Track sanction/construction/payment status
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: ₹1.20 lakh unit assistance in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in specified NE/hill areas; ₹12,000 toilet assistance through SBM-G convergence.
notGuaranteed: Submitting an application does not itself guarantee a house.
Selection is based on prescribed deprivation/exclusion and verification criteria.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay for inclusion in PMAY-G lists.
Do not trust anyone promising guaranteed sanction.

schemes.name: Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0
schemes.authority: Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
schemes.purpose: Provide reliable, adequate and safe rural piped drinking-water services with stronger sustainability, governance and service-delivery systems.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Rural households covered by State/UT rural drinking-water systems.

benefit.nationalGoal: tap water service to all rural households subject to implementation

schemes.documents: Generally not a direct individual cash-application scheme; household coverage is implemented through State/UT rural water-supply programmes.

application.authority: State/UT Rural Water Supply / PHED / Panchayati Raj implementation structure

schemes.deadlines: Mission period extended through December 2028; household-level implementation timelines are State/local-system dependent.
schemes.grievance: State/UT water-supply grievance systems, Gram Panchayat/VWSC and official JJM service-feedback mechanisms.
schemes.stateVariation: Strong State/UT implementation variation in infrastructure, source, service delivery and local management.
aiSafety: JJM 2.0 is a public-service mission, not a ₹ benefit paid directly to households.
Do not promise a personal cash payment.
Check local service status rather than assuming every rural household currently has functional tap water.

source.authority: Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti

howItWorks: State/UT plans and implements rural piped water systems
JJM 2.0 shifts emphasis from infrastructure creation toward service delivery and sustainability
Village-level/community structures support local ownership and operation
Digital mapping and service-area IDs support monitoring
applicationSteps: This is generally not an individual cash-application scheme
Check household connection/service status through Gram Panchayat/State rural water-supply authority
Report non-functionality through the State/local grievance mechanism
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Public drinking-water service delivered through rural piped water infrastructure; no direct household cash benefit is defined by the mission.
notGuaranteed: A rural household's geographic coverage does not by itself prove that its tap has continuous functional water service.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay unofficial persons for a promised JJM household cash benefit; JJM is primarily a public service programme.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
schemes.authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.purpose: Universal access to basic banking, remittance, credit, insurance and pension-related financial services.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Unbanked/eligible individuals seeking a basic savings bank deposit account.

benefit.accidentInsurance: ₹2 lakh for new PMJDY accounts opened after 28.08.2018, subject to applicable conditions
benefit.overdraft: up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders

documents: identity/address/KYC documents as accepted by bank
other bank KYC documents where required
schemes.grievance: Concerned bank grievance mechanism and PMJDY/Department of Financial Services channels.
schemes.stateVariation: Bank-level KYC and service availability may vary; core scheme benefits are centrally defined.
aiSafety: Overdraft is not automatic for every PMJDY account.
Accident insurance is subject to RuPay/card and applicable conditions.
Do not claim ₹10,000 overdraft without checking eligibility.

source.authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

howItWorks: Unbanked person opens BSBD/PMJDY account through bank branch or Bank Mitra
KYC is completed
RuPay card and account services are provided
Eligible account holders may access overdraft and linked government financial services
applicationSteps: Visit a bank branch or Bank Mitra
Submit KYC/identity documents
Open PMJDY/BSBD account
Collect/activate RuPay card as applicable
Link account for DBT where required
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Basic bank account with no minimum balance requirement; RuPay card; eligible account holders may receive overdraft up to ₹10,000; applicable accident insurance with RuPay card; DBT eligibility.
notGuaranteed: Overdraft and insurance benefits have eligibility/usage conditions; they are not automatic cash grants.
fraudWarnings: Never share ATM PIN, OTP or full banking credentials.
Use bank/Bank Mitra or official PMJDY channels.

schemes.name: National Social Assistance Programme
schemes.purpose: Provide central social assistance through old-age, widow and disability pensions and family-benefit/food-grain components.
schemes.targetBeneficiary: Eligible BPL/covered elderly persons, widows, persons with specified disability, and families covered by NFBS/Annapurna components.

igndps.unit: ₹/month central assistance for eligible 80% disability category

nfbs.condition: death of primary breadwinner aged 18-59 in eligible BPL family

annapurna.condition: eligible BPL senior citizens not receiving old-age pension

documents: death certificate and family records for NFBS
schemes.deadlines: Component and State/local process specific; NFBS and Annapurna are demand-based components.
schemes.grievance: State/UT social-assistance and local authority grievance channels.
schemes.stateVariation: States/UTs may add their own contributions; final pension paid to a beneficiary can therefore exceed the central assistance.
aiSafety: Do not state central assistance as the final State pension without checking the State/UT.
Do not assume every elderly person qualifies; applicable BPL/coverage and component criteria apply.
NFBS and Annapurna are distinct components, not monthly pension payments.
howItWorks: State/local authorities identify and verify eligible beneficiaries under NSAP components
Eligible beneficiary is sanctioned under the relevant component
Central assistance and State contribution are processed through the applicable system
Beneficiary can track payment/status through official channels such as NSAP/UMANG where available
applicationSteps: Contact Gram Panchayat/local authority/State social assistance office
Submit age/disability/family/BPL and bank documents as applicable
Complete State/local verification
Track sanction and payment status
schemes.paymentOrDelivery: Central assistance varies by component: IGNOAPS ₹200/month age 60–79 and ₹500 age 80+; IGNWPS ₹300/month age 40–79 and ₹500 age 80+; IGNDPS ₹300/month for eligible 18–79 and ₹500 age 80+; NFBS ₹20,000 one-time; Annapurna 10 kg foodgrains/month for eligible uncovered senior citizens.
notGuaranteed: The central amount is not necessarily the final amount received; States/UTs may add contributions.
NFBS and Annapurna are demand-based components.
fraudWarnings: Do not pay for inclusion in pension lists.
Verify beneficiary status through local authority/NSAP/official channels.
